        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));

        int w = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        while (tmp > 0) {

                c[ind] = 0;

            }

                    c[ind + 1]++;

                    f = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            tmp /= w;
            ind++;
        }
        out.println(f ? "YES" : "NO");
        out.flush();
        out.close();
    }
